Good to know

Questions we get every day

Still not sure about something? Send a WhatsApp message and we'll answer straight away.

Ask a question
How do I place an order?

Message us on WhatsApp at 0907 984 9626 with the piece you want, or send a DM on Instagram (@thatfurnituregirl__) or TikTok (@thatfurnituregirl_). Tell us your colour and size preference and we'll confirm availability, price and delivery.

How long does production take?

Most pieces take 5–10 working days. Wardrobes are usually about 5 days, centre tables about 10 days, and some pieces are available for immediate pickup from the showroom. Large bespoke commissions like the Royal Kinging Set take about 3 months.

Can I change the colour, size or design?

Yes — that is what we do. Every piece can be made in the colour of your choice, resized to fit your room, or redesigned. Send us a photo of what you have in mind.

Do you deliver, and how much does it cost?

We offer same-day delivery in Ibadan and our delivery is quick. Delivery to other states nationwide can be arranged — the cost depends on where you are, so message us for a quote.

Can I see the furniture in person first?

Of course. Our showroom is at Iyaganku, New GRA, Ibadan, and walk-ins are welcome. Message us a little ahead of your visit and we'll have the pieces you're interested in ready for you.

Do you make pieces that aren't on the website?

We build beds, dining sets, office furniture, TV stands and complete house packages. If you can picture it, send us a photo or a sketch and we'll tell you what it costs to build.

Come and see

Walk in, sit down, choose your fabric.

Our showroom is at Iyaganku, New GRA, Ibadan — or send a message and we'll bring the showroom to your phone with photos and videos of what's in stock.

Before you order

Straight answers

Anything else you'd like to know, just ask — we're always active on WhatsApp.

Are the prices on this page final?

They are the prices for the pieces exactly as photographed and described. If you change the fabric, colour or size, or ask for extra detailing, the price may change — we'll always confirm the new price before we start building.

What if the piece I want is out of stock?

Almost nothing is kept "in stock" — most pieces are built to order, so there is no waiting for a shipment. We'll tell you the production time and keep you updated with photos as it comes together.

How do I pay?

Payment details are shared when you place your order on WhatsApp. Ask us about options for made-to-order pieces before we begin production.

Can I mix and match pieces?

Yes. Many customers order a sectional plus a centre table, or a whole living room of matching pieces. Tell us the room and we'll help you put a set together.

Found the one?

Send us the piece name and we'll confirm availability, price and delivery straight away.

Our story

Made by hand, in Ibadan.

You found us on TikTok — probably while scrolling past a cream boucle sectional you couldn't stop thinking about. Behind every one of those videos is a workshop in Iyaganku where the frames are cut, foamed and upholstered by hand.

How it started

From a phone camera to a full workshop.

It started with videos. Short clips of sofas being finished, fabrics being chosen, deliveries going out — posted from Ibadan to anyone who would watch. People started messaging. "Do you deliver to Lagos?" "Can you make this in brown?" "How much for the L-shape?"

So we built more. Today That Furniture Girl is a handcrafted furniture business with a showroom and workshop at Iyaganku, Ibadan, delivering to homes and offices across Nigeria. Same-day delivery is standard in Ibadan, most pieces are built in 5–10 working days, and nothing leaves the workshop until it's right.

Our customers aren't strangers — they found us, watched the process, and stayed. That's a responsibility we take seriously. Every piece is built to last, and every price is confirmed before we start cutting.

The craft

What goes into one piece of furniture

  • Frames — treated wood, joined and reinforced for heavy daily use
  • Foam — high-density fill that keeps its shape instead of sagging
  • Fabric — boucle, corduroy, floral and leather, with options sent to your phone
  • Carcass work — wardrobes, tables and TV stands in HDF and MDF
  • Finishing — hand-stitched details, tufting, piping and custom colours

Quick answers

Before you message

We're always active — but here are the questions that come up most.

Do you deliver outside Ibadan?

Yes. Same-day delivery is available across Ibadan, and we arrange delivery to other states nationwide. Send us your address and we'll tell you the cost before you commit.

How soon can I get my furniture?

Some pieces are available for immediate pickup from the showroom. Built-to-order pieces usually take 5–10 working days — wardrobes around 5 days, centre tables around 10 — and large bespoke commissions take longer.

Can I pay on delivery?

Payment arrangements are agreed on WhatsApp when you order, and we'll always spell out what is due and when before we start building. Ask us directly and we'll explain the options for your piece.

I'm not in Nigeria — can I still order?

Absolutely. We build for customers abroad who are furnishing a home, an apartment or a family property in Nigeria. We'll send photos and videos of progress so you can approve finishes from wherever you are.

Tell us what you need.

One message is usually all it takes to get started — no forms, no waiting.
